subject: Film & Cinema
title: Release Windows and Windowing
description: A quick win: understand Release Windows and Windowing.

hook.text: Films used to follow a strict path: theater, then DVD, then cable, then streaming. That's over.

buildup.text: Release windows maximized revenue by giving each platform an exclusive period.

discovery.text: COVID collapsed windows — films went to streaming weeks after theatrical release.

twist.text: Theater owners are furious. Studios are torn. Audiences just want to watch at home.

climax.text: The future of release windows will determine whether movie theaters survive.

punchline.text: Where you watch decides who gets paid.

quiz.question: What did COVID do to traditional release windows?
options: Collapsed them — films reached streaming much faster
